claims: The Mexican national team (Selección Mexicana) defeated Brazil 3-2 in a legends exhibition match.
The match took place on Sunday, April 19, 2026.
The match took place at 17:00 hours.
The match took place in Estadio Banorte.
Oribe Peralta scored a doublete (two goals) for Mexico.
Luis Hernández scored a goal for Mexico.
Adriano scored a goal for Brazil with an assist from Ronaldinho.
Kaká scored a goal for Brazil.
Miguel Herrera was the Director Técnico (head coach) for Mexico.
Jairzinho was the Director Técnico (head coach) for Brazil.
Cuauhtémoc Blanco, Rafa Márquez, Andrés Guardado, Pável Pardo, and Jared Borgetti.
Ronaldinho, Kaká, Adriano, Lúcio, Maicon, and Julio César.
The match was part of the pre-2026 World Cup activities.
